description: A faithful Codex pet recreation of a quiet snow-country baby macaque curled into a warm fluffy ball, with thick cream-tan winter fur, a soft pink face, tiny ears tucked into the coat, snow clinging to the fur, and a small brass collar detail in a gentle Machinarium winter mood.

idle.notes: Quiet curled-up baseline with tiny breath and blink motion.

walk.notes: Short cautious true-facing walk rows used for movement and drag-facing behavior.

curious.notes: A timid but attentive glance upward or outward at snow or a nearby sound.

happy.notes: A shy satisfied smile with a tiny paw lift kept close to the body.

sleep.notes: A fully tucked sleeping snow-ball pose with soft breathing.

shake.notes: A gentle self-brush and tiny body shake that keeps loosened snow close to the fur.

warm_up.notes: A self-hugging warm-up loop with timid cold-weather huddling.

yawn.notes: A sleepy tucked-in yawn loop while keeping the body compact and warm.

drag.notes: Directional drag reuses the true left-facing and right-facing walk rows.

brush_snow.notes: Shares the same row as shake; the loop includes a close-to-body self-brush before the tiny snow shake.

sunbath.notes: The fixed atlas budget was used first for shake, warm_up, and yawn while preserving the required core actions.

dragFacingValidation.rule: deltaX < 0 => facing left; deltaX > 0 => facing right
manualVerification: left drag uses a true left-facing strip
right drag uses a true right-facing strip
walk_left and walk_right are not swapped
head, muzzle, body lean, paws, feet, and fur flow face left in running-left
head, muzzle, body lean, paws, feet, and fur flow face right in running-right
left drag never faces right and right drag never faces left
